svg.title: Proof-of-concept architecture: Excel files in Amazon S3 opened as a network drive
svg.text: Excel files in Amazon S3, opened as a network drive
This proof of concept runs in the sandbox01 AWS account in the us-east-1 Region. Terraform created every AWS part shown here.

g.text: Runs the AWS VPN Client app.
Runs Excel or the Mac Numbers app.
Runs the AWS VPN Client app.
The router allows port 443, so the
VPN tunnel uses that port instead.
How a file is opened and saved
The user connects the AWS VPN Client. The tunnel runs over TCP port 443,
so it passes through networks that block port 445.
Excel opens and saves files on the share through the tunnel. Every SMB
connection is encrypted, and the share asks for the guest password.
The gateway serves files from its cache disk at disk speed. A save is written
to the cache first, so Excel does not wait for Amazon S3.
The gateway uploads each saved file to the bucket over HTTPS with its IAM role.
Files added straight to the bucket appear on the share within 5 minutes.
The dashed line shows that the Elastic IP address is attached to the gateway. Icons come from the AWS Architecture Icons package released on 31 July 2026.
